sources.quote: Q 'Dark Sphere': castTime = "none"; W 'Force of Will': castTime = "none"; E 'Scatter the Weak': castTime = "0.25"; R 'Unleashed Power': castTime = "0.25"
sources.note: Cached wiki cast-time field. Corpus-wide the field takes the values 'none' (304 abilities), '0.25' (243), '0.5' (35), '0.4', '0.35', ... — so 'none' is a real wiki value meaning no cast time (0 s) and the numeric strings are seconds. Syndra Q's separate '0.6-second delay' in the effect text is the sphere's landing delay, not a cast time, and does not occupy the champion's hands.

sources.quote: Ability recasts are scheduled on **one shared timeline** (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed *and* no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it *starts* within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`). ... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.
Ability rotation casts (`_schedule_shared_casts`, `_compute_ability_rotation`) | shared-timeline renewal schedule; cast starts within window | **EXACT**

independent_computation.model: Per docs 1.1, casts are mutually exclusive on one shared timeline and each cast occupies its sourced cast time. At fight start (t = 0) every ability of the opening rotation is off cooldown, so the greedy schedule packs the opening casts back-to-back: start(k) = sum of the sourced cast times of the k casts that precede it.
independent_computation.formula: start(index 3) = d(cast0) + d(cast1) + d(cast2) = 0.50 - d(cast3), because the four opening casts of a Syndra order sum to 0.0 + 0.0 + 0.25 + 0.25 = 0.50 s
independent_computation.conclusion: 0.0 s is unreachable for the 4th cast of a Syndra rotation. Syndra has only two instant abilities (Q and W, castTime 'none'); E and R each occupy 0.25 s. Any ordering of her four abilities therefore puts at least one 0.25 s cast among the first three, so the 4th cast can start no earlier than 0.25 s. The canonical order Q,W,E,R reproduces the old snapshot exactly — [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.25] — which also explains why this is the only leaf of the timeline that moved: indices 0-2 were already 0.0, and only the 4th cast, the one pushed back by E's 0.25 s cast time, carried a nonzero start. The new 0.0 is what you get if the 0.25 s occupancy stops delaying the following cast, i.e. if cast-time occupancy is dropped from the shared timeline; that contradicts both the cached wiki cast time for E/R and the documented one-set-of-hands model.
independent_computation.alternative_reading_checked: If 'time' were read as the entry's own cast duration rather than its start timestamp, the answer is the same: this is a single-leaf change, so the ability sitting at index 3 is unchanged between runs, and its recorded 0.25 is exactly the wiki's sourced cast time for Scatter the Weak / Unleashed Power. Zeroing it still contradicts data/champions.json, where only Q and W carry castTime 'none'.
independent_computation.residual_uncertainty: The scenario definition (the actual custom cast order and the meaning of '120') lives outside the permitted evidence tree, so the specific ability at index 3 could not be confirmed. The conclusion does not depend on it: 0.0 is unattainable for the 4th cast under every one of the 24 orderings of Syndra's kit, and reaching 0.0 would require three consecutive instant casts, which her kit cannot supply (only Q and W are instant).
